title: Great White Pelican (Pelecanus onocrotalus) sounds
author: Marco Dragonetti
changes: Great white pelicans (Pelecanus onocrotalus) giving low grunting calls while feeding together in the Danube Delta (adult pelicans are mostly silent away from their flocks and colonies). Trimmed to 0.80–3.35 s of the original, mixed to mono, silence trimmed, loudness-normalised (≈ −18 dBFS RMS, peak ≤ −1 dBFS), 10 ms fade-in / 120 ms fade-out, encoded as 96 kbps mono MP3.
